rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges single-image limits, but it overstates expansion as early-to-full rather than clearly matching the provided expanded 3AA context and gives somewhat confident TE/ICM detail despite limited visibility.
Integrates age, FSH, BMI, prior miscarriage, sperm parameters, endometrium, and cycle context well, though AMH is unavailable and some interactions are discussed somewhat broadly rather than deeply.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions generally supported by embryo quality and patient factors; minor tension exists between image-based staging comments and acceptance of the lab grade.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice, including proceeding with transfer, avoiding routine PGT-A after a single miscarriage at age 31, and not recommending bed rest; minor overinterpretation of lining favorability and morphology-performance links prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, counseling, and contingencies after failure or recurrent loss, though recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly protocol-specific.
